name: send-email-kit
description: Fork of firebase/extensions firestore-send-email 0.2.11 (490b13b) as a self-created function kit. See ../README.md.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.proof: npm run build && printf 'SMTP_PASSWORD=emulator-pass\n' > .secret.local && PROOF_SMTP_PASSWORD=emulator-pass npx -y firebase-tools@15.37.0 emulators:exec --config ../../../firebase.mailkit-proof.json --project demo-mailkit --only firestore,functions 'node proof/mail-proof.mjs'
